name: Starling Vestry
tagline: Church admin that doesn't require a seminary degree.
positioning: The tithe-tracking, volunteer-wrangling, bulletin-building backend for small congregations run by one very tired person.

hero.h1: Run the whole church from one boring, beautiful dashboard.
hero.sub: Tithes, rosters, room bookings, and the weekly bulletin — all in one place, so you can stop maintaining nine spreadsheets and a group text named 'Elders (NEW).'

features.title: Giving without guilt trips
features.description: Track pledges, one-time gifts, and recurring tithes. Auto-generate year-end statements so nobody emails you about their taxes in April.

features.title: Volunteer roulette, solved
features.description: Schedule greeters, nursery, and worship teams. When someone bails at 7am Sunday, one tap finds a replacement who actually said yes.

features.title: Bulletins in five minutes
features.description: Drop in announcements, hymns, and the sermon title. We lay it out cleanly and print-ready — no more wrestling Publisher at midnight.

features.title: Members you can actually find
features.description: A directory that knows the Johnsons moved, remembers whose kid is allergic to what, and doesn't leak everyone's phone number.

features.title: Rooms that don't double-book
features.description: Fellowship Hall can't host a funeral and a youth pizza night at once. Starling checks so your deacons don't have to.

features.title: Reminders that reach humans
features.description: Text and email nudges for events, giving, and 'please return the sanctuary chairs.' Set once, stop nagging forever.

testimonials.quote: I used to spend Saturday nights formatting the bulletin and crying a little. Now it's done before dinner and I have a hobby again.
testimonials.name: Pastor Dana Whitfield

testimonials.quote: Our giving statements used to be a January nightmare. Starling spat out 214 of them in about forty seconds. The board thinks I'm a wizard.
testimonials.name: Marcus Ojukwu

testimonials.quote: The volunteer scheduler alone paid for itself. No more 6:45am panic texts hunting for a nursery worker.
testimonials.name: Renee Calloway

pricing.blurb: For tiny congregations and one heroic volunteer.
For a real church with real Sundays.
For multi-site or unreasonably organized folks.

homepage.footerBlurb: Starling Vestry keeps the office running so you can get back to the actual ministry. Built for churches that don't have an IT department.
